page.overview:
Who is Barbara Martin?

Barbara Martin (née Kingston) is a character in the Halloween franchise. She was from Madison, Wisconsin.

Barbara Martin is the wife of Dave Martin and the mother of Alice Martin. On October 31, 1978, Dave had to take his sister Ruby to Hardin County and Barbara decided to tag along. Alice was left home alone and would end up being murdered by Michael Myers.
